cohort: 70 pregnant women from one hospital, including 20 with early-onset severe preeclampsia, 20 with late-onset severe preeclampsia, and 30 healthy pregnant women, who were treated between January and November 2023.
finding: Pregnant women with severe preeclampsia (SPE) showed significantly reduced irisin levels in both serum and placental tissues compared to healthy pregnant women, and these levels were negatively correlated with systolic and/or diastolic blood pressure.
mod_finding: There was a significant difference in the mode of delivery between the control group and the early-onset and late-onset severe preeclampsia groups.
cross-section timing: Around the time of delivery, with fasting peripheral blood samples collected and placental tissues obtained after delivery.
